title: Shooting out the lights in dance halls
summary: Vincent describes drunk patrons shooting the lights out in dance halls.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: You were talking about how they used to shoot the light out. Tell us more about that.

Tell them more about when they used to shoot the lights out in the dance hall. They get drunk and they have a gun on them. Just put it out and shoot. There are so many people there and the police will be on them and they get scared.
